t: The Hager Sollysta WMP50FO 45A unswitched flex outlet offers a secure and reliable electrical connection for fixed appliances. With a raised slim profile and a screwed faceplate, this electrical accessory requires a 25mm back box for installation. Angled in-line terminals with backed-out captive screws provide straightforward wiring. A protective red washer prevents cable damage.
b: Angled In-Line Terminals with Backed-Out Captive Screws
Protective Red Washer Prevents Damage to Cable
